meta.title: Baltimore MedTech live data workbook
meta.description: One spreadsheet-style page per source, with live queries for public APIs and explicit repository-snapshot labels for curated local datasets.
meta.live_definition: Live means the page queries the publisher or its release metadata through the MedTech Worker when opened. Repository snapshots remain versioned inputs and are never labeled live.
meta.privacy_note: The workbook exposes public aggregate and provider-directory data only. It does not retrieve patient-level records or restricted claims files.

datasets.title: CMS Doctors and Clinicians — National Downloadable File
datasets.description: Live clinician, enrollment, group, practice-location, specialty, facility, and telehealth rows. One clinician can appear more than once across enrollments, organizations, and locations.
limitations: Rows are unique at the clinician/enrollment/group/address level, not at the person level.
Medicare enrollment and Care Compare listing do not establish appointment availability or acceptance of every payer.

datasets.title: CMS Medicare Physician & Other Practitioners — by Provider and Service
datasets.description: Live provider-by-HCPCS rows with beneficiary, service, charge, allowed-amount, and payment measures. This is a much closer measure of realized Medicare activity than provider headcount.
limitations: Covers Original Medicare fee-for-service, not Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, commercial insurance, uninsured care, or a provider's entire practice.
Small beneficiary counts are suppressed under CMS disclosure rules.

datasets.title: NPPES NPI Registry
datasets.description: Live NPI identity, taxonomy, and practice-address records flattened to one row per returned NPI. NPI enumeration is an identity layer, not proof of licensure, credentialing, activity, or payer participation.
limitations: An NPI does not prove that a provider is licensed, credentialed, clinically active, accepting new patients, or participating with a payer.
The API returns search results rather than a full bulk census in one request.

datasets.title: BLS OEWS — Baltimore Medical Labor
datasets.description: Live employment and wage estimates for selected physician, nursing, therapy, imaging, laboratory, genetics, health-information, and management occupations in the Baltimore metropolitan area or Maryland.
limitations: OEWS estimates wage-and-salary employment and generally exclude self-employed workers.
Some detailed estimates are unavailable or suppressed, and a broad occupation may not map cleanly to one medical specialty.

datasets.title: HRSA Area Health Resources Files — Release Files
datasets.coverage: 2024–2025 AHRF release; source variables have differing reference years
datasets.description: Live release-file metadata for the current AHRF CSV downloads. The page exposes publisher headers and direct downloads; extracting all 6,000-plus variables remains a separate ingestion job.
limitations: This live page verifies and links the current release files; it does not stream a multi-million-cell ZIP into the browser.
Reference years differ by variable and must be read from AHRF metadata before comparison.

datasets.title: Maryland Medicaid Provider Verification System
datasets.description: Live source inspection of Maryland's public fee-for-service provider-verification portal. The page extracts available provider-type options when possible and links to the official search; Maryland does not publish a documented bulk PVS API here.
limitations: PVS verifies fee-for-service enrollment status for a date; an active result does not necessarily mean the provider accepts payment or every Medicaid managed-care plan.
This page cannot bulk-download provider records because no documented public bulk API is exposed by the state portal.

datasets.title: Maryland Medicaid Provider Finder
datasets.coverage: Current Maryland Medicaid and HealthChoice directory entry points
datasets.description: Live source-status sheet for Maryland Medicaid’s Provider Finder guidance and search tool. It preserves the distinction between accepting Medicaid and participating in a particular HealthChoice managed-care plan.
limitations: The official directory is an interactive lookup, not a documented public bulk API, so this sheet reports live source status and directs users to the search rather than scraping provider results.
Maryland says all listed providers and facilities accept Medicaid, but not every provider accepts every HealthChoice plan.
